summary: Short frontend regression of the iteration_7 follow-ups at 390x844, run with Playwright against Expo web. Everything requested passed. 1) Verb search now covers both tabs. On /practice/pv-mm1aa, with tab-regular active, 'cut' returns only verb-option-cut (no 'discuss'). 'bro' returns break (broken) and bring (brought). Spanish prefixes work too ('romp' gives break, 'cort' gives cut). Input is trimmed and case-insensitive ('  CUT ' gives cut). A query with no match shows verb-empty. Clearing the search restores the tab lists (93 regular, 67 irregular). 2) Selecting cut, then subject I, then Generar gives 'I am cut.' / 'I am not cut.' / 'Am I cut?'. The Spanish line reads 'Yo soy cortado.' and structure-live reads 'I + am + Pasado Participio'. The search is cleared when the modal is reopened. 3) The header back-button measures 44x44. The bookmark icon is gone; a 44x44 empty spacer on the right keeps the title centred. 4) Navigation regression: home, section-passive (8 modules), pv-mm1aa, back, home all work, and so does home, section-bat (5 modules), bat-mm1b, back, home. Opening a practice URL directly in a fresh tab and tapping back goes to /section/passive.

issues: While a search is active the results come from both tabs, but the 'Regulares' tab still looks selected. Consider dimming both tabs or showing a 'Resultados en ambos grupos' hint while the search has text.

action_items: Optional: while a search is active, show that the results cover both tabs (e.g. dim the active tab).
Optional: practice/[id].tsx:30 silently shows pv-mm1aa for an unknown id (e.g. /practice/bat-mm1aa renders the passive Mm1.AA screen). Consider redirecting to home or a not-found screen instead.
critical_code_review_comments: practice/[id].tsx:78: the search compares against v.es with startsWith, but there is no accent normalisation. A user typing without an accent may miss a match if any Spanish infinitive starts with an accented letter. Minor.
practice/[id].tsx:30: the findPractice fallback hides bad routes (see action_items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tap RN Pressables with dispatch_event('click'). The verb search now covers both tabs (prefix match on en, pp or es). Header: back-button 44x44 plus an empty 44x44 spacer. Section screens also expose a back-button. Valid BAT practice ids are of the form bat-mm1b and so on.
